description: Linter assumption keys (xdrlint, the assumption field of each diagnostic) mapped to the mainnet inputs that violate them: a value tag of the dataset, a token class, a token substring or an operation type. A key with no entry has no mainnet selector yet; find says so.

assumptions.why: 64-bit unsigned values above what float64 holds exactly
token balances far beyond 2^53 raw units
strings (memos among them) with invalid UTF-8
strings with invalid UTF-8, NUL, control bytes or maximal length
muxed (M…) accounts where a G… address may be expected
token-shaped events from contracts that are not a Stellar Asset Contract
every TransactionMeta arm mainnet has shown
lengths at the maximum their type allows
